one_liner: Cloud accounting software providing a robust REST API for invoices, contacts, bank transactions, and financial reporting.
access_notes: A developer account is free and self-serve, taking 30 seconds to create and providing access to create apps and use the Demo Company.
verdict_reason: Xero provides a self-serve developer portal, free account sign-up, OpenAPI specs, official SDKs, and an official MCP server.

evidence.snippet: Note: Xero doesn't use traditional API keys. Instead, it uses OAuth 2.0 authentication with Client ID and Client Secret credentials.
Developer account (free, takes 30 seconds to create)
The Xero API is an OAuth 2.0 REST API

Xero-OpenAPI Public
An OpenAPI description of the Xero API
Xero has a Demo Company for testing. Use it.
Yes — Xero has an official MCP server. It’s published by XeroAPI
Yes. Xero publishes the open-source XeroAPI/xero-mcp-server repository and the @xeroapi/xero-mcp-server npm package.
